---
title: "06 — taxonomic vs. functional turnover (PICRUSt2)"
subtitle: "Figure 6 of the ISME / Microbiome manuscript"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
---

Figure 6 asks whether taxonomically-different communities in the Empty
Quarter encode the same metabolic capacity. We use PICRUSt2-predicted
MetaCyc pathways and explicitly caveat the result: PICRUSt2 leans on
reference genomes that are under-represented for hyperarid desert taxa,
so **any "functional redundancy" signal has to be interpreted as an
upper bound on redundancy** (Sun et al. 2020 *Microbiome*).

* **A.** Pairwise BC dissimilarity — taxonomic (ASV) vs functional
  (pathway) — marginal densities.
* **B.** Taxonomic vs. functional distance-decay slopes per compartment.
* **C.** Procrustes comparison of the two ordinations.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
REPO = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from eq import CACHE_DIR, FIGURES_DIR, DATA_DIR
from eq.beta import bray_curtis, pcoa
from eq.loader import load_picrust_pathways

plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 120, "font.size": 9,
                     "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
```

## Load + align feature table to PICRUSt2 samples

```{python}
#| label: load
ft = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "feature_table.parquet")
meta = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "metadata.parquet").dropna(subset=["trip","compartment"]).copy()
meta["trip"] = meta["trip"].astype(int); meta["site"] = meta["site"].astype(int)
ft = ft[meta.index]
pw = load_picrust_pathways()
print(f"ASV table: {ft.shape};  PICRUSt2 table: {pw.shape}")

# Both tables use the same sample-ID convention (e####_<stem>)
shared_samples = [s for s in ft.columns if s in pw.columns]
print(f"Shared samples: {len(shared_samples)}")
pw_aln = pw[shared_samples]
ft_aln = ft[shared_samples]
meta_aln = meta.loc[shared_samples]
```

## A. Bray–Curtis on ASV vs pathway

```{python}
#| label: fig6a
d_tax = bray_curtis(ft_aln)
d_fun = bray_curtis(pw_aln)

iu = np.triu_indices(d_tax.shape[0], k=1)
v_tax = d_tax.to_numpy()[iu]
v_fun = d_fun.to_numpy()[iu]
print(f"Mean BC — taxonomic: {v_tax.mean():.3f}")
print(f"Mean BC — functional: {v_fun.mean():.3f}")
print(f"Ratio (fun/tax): {v_fun.mean() / v_tax.mean():.3f}")

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
r_tf, p_tf = spearmanr(v_tax, v_fun)
print(f"Spearman rho(tax, fun) = {r_tf:.3f} (p={p_tf:.2e})")
```

```{python}
#| label: fig6a-plot
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.8))
ax1.hist(v_tax, bins=60, alpha=0.6, color="#1f77b4", label="taxonomic (ASV)")
ax1.hist(v_fun, bins=60, alpha=0.6, color="#d62728", label="functional (pathway)")
ax1.set_xlabel("pairwise Bray–Curtis"); ax1.set_ylabel("pair count")
ax1.legend(frameon=False)
ax2.hexbin(v_tax, v_fun, gridsize=50, cmap="Greys", bins="log", mincnt=1)
ax2.set_xlabel("taxonomic BC"); ax2.set_ylabel("functional BC")
ax2.plot([0,1],[0,1],"--",color="grey",lw=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig6a_tax_vs_func.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## B. Distance-decay slopes — tax vs func

```{python}
#| label: fig6b-decay
from scipy.stats import linregress
from eq.loader import load_site_geodata

geo = load_site_geodata().reset_index()
site_coord = (geo.drop_duplicates("site")[["site", "Latitude", "Longitude"]]
              .dropna().astype({"site": int}).set_index("site"))

site_of = meta_aln["site"].to_dict()
lat = np.array([site_coord.loc[site_of[s], "Latitude"] for s in shared_samples])
lon = np.array([site_coord.loc[site_of[s], "Longitude"] for s in shared_samples])
def hav(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371
    dlat = np.radians(lat2 - lat1); dlon = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = np.sin(dlat/2)**2 + np.cos(np.radians(lat1))*np.cos(np.radians(lat2))*np.sin(dlon/2)**2
    return 2 * R * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
gm = hav(lat[:, None], lon[:, None], lat[None, :], lon[None, :])

rows = []
for comp in ("surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"):
    idx = np.where(meta_aln["compartment"].values == comp)[0]
    iu = np.triu_indices(len(idx), k=1)
    x = gm[np.ix_(idx, idx)][iu]
    for label, dm in (("tax", d_tax), ("fun", d_fun)):
        y = 1.0 - dm.to_numpy()[np.ix_(idx, idx)][iu]
        ok = (x > 0) & np.isfinite(y)
        slope, intercept, r, p, _ = linregress(np.log10(x[ok]), y[ok])
        rows.append({"compartment": comp, "metric": label,
                     "slope": slope, "R2": r**2, "n_pairs": len(x[ok])})
decay_tf = pd.DataFrame(rows)
decay_tf.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "distance_decay_tax_vs_func.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
decay_tf
```

```{python}
#| label: fig6b-plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))
width = 0.35
comps = ["surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"]
for i, metric in enumerate(("tax", "fun")):
    vals = [decay_tf.query(f"compartment == @c and metric == @metric").iloc[0]["slope"]
            for c in comps]
    ax.bar(np.arange(len(comps)) + i*width, vals, width,
           label=f"{metric}onomic" if metric=="tax" else "functional",
           color=["#1f77b4", "#d62728"][i])
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(comps)) + width/2); ax.set_xticklabels(comps)
ax.set_ylabel("slope (per log10 km)")
ax.legend(frameon=False); ax.axhline(0, color="grey", lw=0.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig6b_decay_tax_vs_func.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## C. Procrustes comparison

```{python}
#| label: fig6c-procrustes
from scipy.spatial import procrustes

pc_tax, _ = pcoa(d_tax, n_components=2)
pc_fun, _ = pcoa(d_fun, n_components=2)
common = pc_tax.index.intersection(pc_fun.index)
m1, m2, disparity = procrustes(pc_tax.loc[common].to_numpy(),
                                pc_fun.loc[common].to_numpy())
print(f"Procrustes disparity (lower = better fit): {disparity:.4f}")
# Mantel-style coupling: correlation of row-wise distances between the two spaces
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist
d_tax_flat = pdist(m1); d_fun_flat = pdist(m2)
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
r, p = spearmanr(d_tax_flat, d_fun_flat)
print(f"Within-PCoA distance correlation: ρ = {r:.3f} (p={p:.2e})")
```

## Caveat

> **Note for the Discussion.** Sun et al. (2020, *Microbiome*) showed
> that PICRUSt2 accuracy degrades for hyperarid or host-associated
> communities because reference genomes skew toward cultured and mesic
> taxa. The "functional redundancy" ratio here should be reported as
> *an upper bound* on true redundancy; a fraction of the apparent
> functional conservation may reflect PICRUSt2 collapsing novel
> desert ASVs onto a small set of reference genomes.
